description: [wallet-required, $0.001/call] End-of-day US equity quote: last close, day range, consolidated volume, previous close and the change between them. US equities only; indices, FX and crypto are not covered (crypto-price serves those). Built from the official consolidated end-of-day summary across all US exchanges and ATSs, so price, range and volume are market totals. If that dataset is unavailable for a read, the answer comes from a consolidation of three U.S. exchange venues instead and says so: coverage reads three-venue, venueVolume counts those venues only and volume is null. No 52-week range and no intraday print: for a date range call stock-history. Each answer names its dataset and coverage, and says whether its bars came from this session's cache (cached, fetchedAt). Returns { symbol, currency, price, previousClose, changeAbs, changePct, dayHigh, dayLow }. This hosted connector holds no wallet: pay it here over MPP, or run npx agent402-mcp with a funded wallet (AGENT_KEY) or a prepaid credits key already issued (AGENT402_CREDITS_KEY), or any x402 client.

symbol.description: US equity ticker, e.g. AAPL. Indices, FX and crypto are not covered.
